passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Eragrostis tenuifolia (A.Rich.) Hochst. ex Steud..
The native range of this species is Africa to Indo-China. It is a perennial or annual and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome. It is used as a medicine.
